response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS st, COALESCE(SUM(ft.transaction_amount), 0) AS total FROM Financial_Transactions ft JOIN Accounts a ON a.account_id = ft.account_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), s AS (SELECT st, total, total * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total) FROM t) AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.total) AS combined_total, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
